2.198.12
RadialScale.MaximumPin
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.MaximumPin element specifies the maximum value at which a PointerImage on a
RadialScale will stop. This element is optional. This element is of type ScalePin.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.MaximumPin element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.MaximumPin element.
 <xsd:element name="MaximumPin" type="ScalePinType" minOccurs="0" />
